name: vince
caption:
VINSANITY 🎮🏀 February 12, 2000, Oakland. A Raptor walks into the dunk contest and changes it forever.

• Reverse 360 windmill: 50
• Between the legs off a Tracy McGrady bounce: 50
• Elbow in the rim: 50
• Three perfect 50s, the first since 1992

Best dunk contest ever? 👇
